provenance: Schema-derived from autotune_runs table (database.py save_autotune_run signature, migrations/006_autotune_runs_sharpe.sql, migrations/007_autotune_runs_frozen_eval.sql). Numeric shapes validated against O2 (deflated_sharpe = DSR-corrected trial winner) and O6 (frozen_eval_sharpe = withheld final-20%-fold metric). Values chosen to be non-trivially distinct so formatting assertions can distinguish all three fields.
description: Autotune run row where all three surfacing fields are present: naive_sharpe (raw Optuna best), deflated_sharpe (DSR-corrected), frozen_eval_sharpe (honest post-selection metric). deflated_sharpe < naive_sharpe by construction (DSR deflates). frozen_eval_sharpe is independently computed on withheld fold.
